# Smelt

> Smelt is a Cape Town, South Africa-based sauna hat brand. Its online store sells 100% merino wool felt sauna hats and publishes guides on sauna hats, fit, materials, and care.

The official website is https://saunahat.co.za. Smelt sauna hats are embroidered front and back, come in Forest Green and Natural Cream, and have a one-size fit. The store ships nationwide in South Africa from Cape Town.

For current pricing, colour availability, and pre-order options, consult the live product page. For shipping, returns, and guarantees, consult the store policies rather than assuming terms from this summary. Sauna guides provide general information, not personalised medical advice.

## Store and brand

- [Home](https://saunahat.co.za/): Introduction to Smelt and its sauna hats.
- [Smelt sauna hat](https://saunahat.co.za/product): Product specifications, colours, current prices, availability, and purchasing options.
- [Our story](https://saunahat.co.za/our-story): The founders, the meaning of the name Smelt, and the story behind the hats.

## Customer support
